title: Claude Cowork does your admin work for you
description:
This Claude Cowork tutorial shows how to use Claude Cowork on the desktop app, connect Gmail, Google Drive and Calendar, then let it read your inbox, draft replies and run skills. The Claude cowork setup that turns the AI into a real assistant. 

Get the step-by-step walkthrough here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L7rCfi7lJazjDFc1aEoJVU7ao9CFBVLx/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
transcript: Here's what to do when you start using Clawd. First, download the Clawd desktop app. It's free. Open it up and instead of the chat window, go to the tab that says co-work because chat is just for asking questions and co-work is for getting real work done. First thing, connect your tools. Click add connector, pick something like Gmail, sign in, and now Clawd can see your whole inbox. Do the same with Google Drive, calendar, Slack, whatever you use. Now watch this. You type, "Go through my inbox, find every email asking about pricing and draft a reply to each one." It reads 40 emails, writes 40 replies, and lines them up for you to check before anything sends. Then there are skills where you hand Clawd a process once and it repeats it forever. You type, "Whenever I say draft a proposal, pull the right meeting from my notes and use this format." Paste your template in and now anytime you say draft a proposal, it writes it exactly how you want. Comment desktop below and I'll send you a step-by-step video on setting this up.
